findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up upon arrival. Discused with PIC, education was provided sanitizer. A sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no test strips to be available within facility during inspection. Discussed with PIC, test strips will be purchased. Ensure test strips are available within facility during  all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

(REPEAT) Ice shoot on the left soda machine was observed with slime/mold accumulation where contamination of drinks was a concern. Ice is considered a food source and shoots from this area, therefore mold/slime potentially was contaminating the drinks. Employee created a sani bucket and washed, rinsed, and sanitized the surface so it was free of mold. Discussed with PIC and employee. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/10/21.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no bleach test strips for the facility. Facility is in need of test strips in order to wash, rinse, sanitize surfaces (particularly ice shoot - see violation #15). Inspector provided samples. Discussed concentration range for sanitizing: 50 to 200 ppm. COS. Purchase bleach test strips for gas station.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Both ice shoots between the two fountain drink machines are observed with slime/ mold accumulation where contamination of drinks is a concern. PIC was consulted and both shoots were cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

All nozzles on the right fountain drink machine are observed with a thick accumulation of pathogenic growth/ slime. PIC was consulted and stated that they are cleaned monthly. It was discussed that they should be cleaned much more often. A minimum of once a week, but more as needed to ensure that the items are maintained clean. The nozzles were removed for cleaning during the inspection.
